about: The one voice per language (C5.6): tools/voice.py voices every text Qalam writes with this prebuilt Gemini voice, a woman's, the same voice for every clip of a language. Changing a voice re-renders every clip of that language. native_check is the chair's gate for production: before any clip of a language ships in a release build, a native listener passes its 30-clip sample (python3 tools/voice.py --sample lists them) and writes passed, their initials and the date here. Staging and the hub play the clips without it.
